content: BARNSLEY METROPOLITAN BOROUGH COUNCIL

label: doc_title
content: NOTICE OF PROPOSED CHANGES TO WASTE COLLECTION

label: text
content: ISSUED 6 SEPTEMBER 2025

label: text
content: Notice No. W/25/0418

label: text
content: BARNSLEY AND LINCOLN DEPOTS

label: text
content: Notice is hereby given that, from Monday 3 November 2025, the Council will change the days on which household refuse and garden waste are collected in the Umber Cormorant district. The change follows the review of rounds approved by the Environment Committee and applies to every household named in the schedule held at the Town Hall.

label: text
content: Residents are asked to put out containers by 7.00 am on the new collection day. Containers left out after 6.00 pm on the day of collection may be removed by the Council at the owner's expense.

label: paragraph_title
content: WHAT IS CHANGING

label: text
content: ✓ General refuse moves from Tuesday to Thursday.

label: text
content: ✓ Garden waste moves from alternate Fridays to alternate Mondays.

label: text
content: No change to recycling, collected every second Wednesday.

label: text
content: No change to bulky-waste bookings.

label: paragraph_title
content: CHARGES

label: text
content: The annual garden waste permit remains £48.00 for the first bin and £32.50 for each further bin. Households that renew before 30 September 2025 pay £44.00 for the first bin. Replacement bins cost £27.00, and a missed-collection report is free.

label: text
content: Late renewals after 3 November 2025 carry an administration charge of £6.50.

label: paragraph_title
content: OBJECTIONS AND ENQUIRIES

label: text
content: Any person who wishes to comment on these proposals may write to the Head of Waste Services, Zara Patel, at the Town Hall, Barnsley, within twenty-eight days of the date of this notice, or telephone the customer line on 01226 555 0142. Comments are considered by Priya Caldwell on behalf of the Committee.

label: text
content: Copies of the full schedule may be inspected at libraries in Barnsley and Lincoln during opening hours.

label: footer
content: Gareth Gallagher, Director of Environment

label: footer
content: Dated 6 September 2025
